newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 15.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 15.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported on Radio Latvia on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- President Giuntis Ulmanis does not accept the idea of just one Baltic state joining NATO, he said during a visit to France.
- A parliamentary investigation committes on G-24 credits and the privatisation of banks is being blocked by the ruling political elite, Social Democrat MP Janis Adamsons said.
- Latvia signed an egreement with Denmark on finacial support for EU integration. Denmark has granted 60 million DKK to both Baltic states and Poland this year.
